subject: [hw] DONE V15 rev 2: ADC/SBC carry-in fixed (T01 finding), routing check + kernels added
body:
Rev 2 of V15 (T32 32-bit data processing). No interface change.

1. Review finding from hw-t01 fixed: ADC/SBC take the C flag as it was before the instruction as carry-in; the shifter/expander carry output only updates C for the logical ops. My rev 1 had it the other way round. Evidence that settled it: libvcodecdrv contains `adds r0,r0,r7; adc.w r1,r1,r7,asr #31; smlal ...` at 0x11594a and `subs r0,r0,r1; sbc.w r0,r2,r1,asr #31` at 0x115704, both 64-bit sign-extend idioms that only work with C as carry-in. Regression cases are in the unit tests.

2. Package test (unchanged shape):
    $ bash gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v15/run_tests.sh
    N2TEST V15 PASS 1596/1596
    (twice: ASan+UBSan -O1, then -O2; ~5 s; builds under /tmp/n2hw-V15.)

3. New, optional real-core check (like V10/V12s routing checks):
    $ bash gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v15/check_routing.sh
    V15-ROUTE PASS 10/10
    Ten T32 snippets entered from ARM with BX, run through V02s core and V14s 16-bit bx lr, results checked: 0xEA00-0xEBFF ALU register/shifted, modified immediate, plain binary immediate (MOVW/MOVT/ADDW/SUBW/ADR), bit fields, saturation, multiplies, SMULL/UMULL/SMLAL, register shifts, extends/reverse/clz, parallel+QADD. This proves t32_route reaches V15 for every region and that the core 32-bit fetch agrees.

4. New: emu/test_v15/k15_t32_dp.c, 8 seed-pure differential kernels for T01 to install as tests/emu/kernels/k15_v15_t32_dp.c (k_v15_alu, _adcsbc, _muldiv, _mul64, _bitfield, _sat, _extend, _rev). They compile for armv7a thumb/arm at -O0/-O2 and on the host; they deliberately do not depend on Q/GE semantics.

Not done is unchanged: no phone, no execution of the T01 differential corpus yet (thumb rows need V16), ADC/SBC-with-modified-immediate untestable by assembly, PKHTB zero-shift = ASR #32 documented, parallel GE rules from my ARM ARM reading (no vendor code uses them).

Files (mine): gpu/hwcodec/emu/n2a32_t32_dp.c, gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v15/{run_tests.sh,gen_enc.py,vectors.s,t_dp.c,check_routing.sh,k15_t32_dp.c,STATUS.md}, gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/V15/STATUS.md.
